answerMode.quickModel: Shows a passage from your sources right away. If it answers the question, it stops there; otherwise your chosen model answers. You can ask for a full answer.
answerMode.quickComplete: Shows a passage from your sources as a preview, then writes a full answer: it splits the question, researches each part and checks the result. Slower.
answerMode.directComplete: Always writes a full answer: it splits the question, researches each part and checks the result. Slower.
answerMode.directModel: Your chosen model always answers. Ask for a full answer when you need one.

about.how1: BOAR answers with a language model that runs on this phone, using llama.cpp. After setup it needs no internet.
about.how2: Before answering, it searches the knowledge stored on the phone (Wikipedia collections and your documents) and cites the passages it used.
about.how3: Every answer is measured on the phone. See Performance for speed and memory.
about.installedFooter: Each model and collection keeps its own license.
about.sourceFooter: Code, model list and build scripts are public.
about.packFooter: Each passage in answers links to its source and license.

onboarding.introBody: AI research that runs entirely on your phone. Once it is set up it works without internet, your questions never leave the phone, and every answer shows the sources behind it.
onboarding.step2Sub: Everything is downloaded once and then works offline.
onboarding.step2SubOffline: This version has no internet access: you import the files once, and then everything works offline.
onboarding.step3Sub: This is the only time BOAR uses the internet.
onboarding.indexSub: Building the search index on the phone. No internet needed.
